helpful: The blinded staging area with a captured retrieval_log.json per candidate, including result_capture markers, made the forward leakage check mechanical.
The statpack salience-band table renders its full Term window with the version in the heading, so the base-rate basis resolved without ambiguity.
Each candidate's frozen context block carried both band and salience_version, so no fallback reasoning was needed.
gaps: A pre-pooled strictly-prior-Term risk-set rate per (band, version, Term) in the statpack would remove the hand-pooling step every evaluator repeats and the rounding it introduces.
A one-line statement in the candidate's staged prediction.json of when the event resolved relative to created_at would let the forward check be read off the record rather than cross-referenced.
notes: Cert cell, all three candidates forward and pre-conference; outcome denied at first distribution. Nothing blocked the evaluation.
